note: Frozen six-round acceptance for the 0->8 same-scene composite: three pre-selected LIBERO init indices (0, 1, 2), one English and one Chinese raw instruction per index. Every round loads task 8 at that index once and never resets, reloads, mutates the BDDL or teleports an object inside the episode. Rounds are never retried or skipped; failures are kept. The seed-0 pair was also used by earlier development probes (documented in the acceptance report), so this file is frozen before the acceptance run, not before all development.

rounds.instruction: Open the middle drawer of the cabinet, then put the bowl on the plate.
先打开柜子中间的抽屉，再把碗放到盘子上。
Slide the middle drawer open and afterwards set the bowl down on the plate.
拉开中间的抽屉，接着把碗放到盘子上。
Before you put the bowl on the plate, get the middle drawer of the cabinet open.
把碗放到盘子上之前，先把柜子中间的抽屉打开。
